dialogues.speaker: Irmgard
dialogues.text: Oh, I'm just going over the family business ledgers.

dialogues.speaker: Irmgard
dialogues.text: Trade in Dornman Port is pretty intricate. If I don't keep a close eye on things, those cunning merchants will always find a way to play tricks.

dialogues.speaker: Irmgard
dialogues.text: Heh, fools. Even the tyrant of Imunlaukr couldn't pull one over on us. If they think they can get the better of Dornmannshaven family, they're got another thing coming.
